declare const theme: { current: string };
export const view = <div className={theme.current} />;

declare const active: boolean;
export const view = <div className={`theme-${active ? "a" : "b"}`} />;

declare function resolveTheme(): string;
export const view = <div className={resolveTheme()} />;

declare const index: number;
export const view = <div className={index + 1} />;

declare const tone: string;
export const view = <div className={`theme-${`nested-${tone}`}`} />;

declare const theme: string;
export const view = <div className={`theme-${({ theme })}`} />;
